quote: until I saw that it was embarrassingly obvious
content: The essay's criterion is not the feeling but what came with it: three days of working through the derivation until he could "see its truth," and then the standard the essay states, "putting in numbers and getting out results that control your anticipation." Rozenblit and Keil show that the illusion of understanding collapses when people try to produce the explanation (Rozenblit & Keil 2002). Three days of derivation is that attempt, carried all the way through. A sense of obviousness earned by reconstructing the result is the calibrated kind.

quote: putting in numbers and getting out results that control your anticipation of particular experiences
content: The essay counts qualitative anticipation as understanding, in so many words: "Even if the student just visualizes something flowing, and therefore holds a match near the cooler side of the plate to try to measure where the heat goes, then this mental image of flowing-ness connects to experience; it controls anticipation." The Force Concept Inventory measures exactly that, qualitative predictions about what objects will do (Hestenes, Wells & Swackhamer 1992). Students who plug numbers into equations without anticipating anything are the essay's password-guessers with more symbols, and the essay says so: "Even visualizing the symbols of the diffusion equation... doesn't mean you've formed a hypothesis about the metal plate."

quote: which must be the correct answer because the teacher heard a physicist emit the same sound-vibrations
content: Testimony passes on a belief only when the hearer has a belief to receive, and the essay's point is that the nine-year-old did not have one: he "had not had the vaguest idea of what the word 'wave' meant to a physicist." What spread was the sentence. Hardwig's layperson trusts the expert about a proposition he understands well enough to act on (Hardwig 1991). What Is Evidence's contagion likewise requires entanglement, and a string whose content the hearer cannot unpack entangles him with nothing except the teacher's approval. The essay does not mock trusting physicists. It mocks mistaking a sound for a belief.
